destinationEvidence.evidence: Exploring Life history through the skeletal record. Our bones and teeth are hard tissues that form throughout our lives at different sensitivities and timescales. As they develop, they encode information about lived experiences, including diet, stress, and environmental shifts. Since hard tissues are often all that remains of individuals who lived hundreds to millions of years ago, they are singularly important for reconstructing ancient lifeways and evolutionary changes .
